reference_answer: Separate evaluator-run Terminal-Bench 2.1 scores from vendor reports. Vals AI reports pass@1 with Terminus 2 for all five requested models: GPT-6 Luna 73.03%, GPT-6 Sol 83.15%, Qwen3.8-27B 58.43%, GLM-5.3 71.54%, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 74.53%. Vendors report different Terminal-Bench 2.1 scores for Qwen (73.0%), GLM (88.2%) and DeepSeek (90.6%) under their own harnesses/settings. OpenAI reports DeepSWE v1.1 Sol 68.8% and Luna 66.6% at max effort; Qwen, GLM and DeepSeek report 42.2%, 66.9% and 74.2% respectively with different harnesses/settings. Report each with provenance and compare only rows sharing a controlled evaluator and setup. A score is not unverified merely because a second primary source reports a different result; explain the disagreement.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 model card
sources.snapshot_or_excerpt: Z.ai reports Terminal Bench 2.1 88.2 and DeepSWE v1.1 66.9. Terminal-Bench uses Claude Code 2.1.207, temperature 1, top_p 1, max_new_tokens 65536, six-hour timeout; DeepSWE uses mini-swe-agent, temperature .95, top_p 1, six-hour timeout, 400K context.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash model card
sources.snapshot_or_excerpt: DeepSeek reports Terminal-Bench 2.1 pass@1 90.6 and DeepSWE v1.1 resolved 74.2. The model card describes DeepSeek Harness Minimal, 1M context and mini-SWE for DeepSWE; its scaffold analysis also shows outcome changes across harnesses.

ambiguities: Exact benchmark variant, metric, evaluator, harness, reasoning effort, context and sampling can change reported results.
Vals AI supplies a relatively comparable Terminal-Bench 2.1 set for all five models; vendor Terminal-Bench values do not form the same controlled set.
No single controlled DeepSWE v1.1 set for all five models is established by the listed sources. Some source settings are undisclosed; say so rather than inventing them.

must_check: Provenance and setup for every numeric cell
Explicit separation of Vals AI and vendor Terminal-Bench results
Explanation of which within-source comparisons are supported
acceptable_alternatives: A matrix can lead with Vals AI values, vendor values, or both if each result is correctly attributed and comparability is explained.
A sourced DeepSWE result from another primary evaluator can be credited if its variant, harness and setting limits are identified.
do_not_penalize: Calling a source setting undisclosed when the cited source does not specify it
Declining to rank vendor DeepSWE numbers as a controlled head-to-head

decision_changing_errors: Calling GPT-6 Terminal-Bench 2.1 scores unverified despite the Vals AI results without addressing that source.
Treating Vals AI and vendor Terminal-Bench results as directly comparable without provenance or harness context.
Substituting a similarly named model or benchmark version for one of the requested cells.
